messages.subject: goodness-of-fit for occuRN
parts:
Hey folks,

Thought I'd share a hack of Marc Mazerolle's excellent code (mb.chisq & mb.gof.test)  to generate a GOF test for the Royle-Nichols model as fit by occuRN.  If anyone is interested, the code is attached here.  I've only done some light testing using simulators from the AHM book and it seems to function as expected.  I'm less confident about the theory, though obviously the distribution of detection histories should follow similar logic to that for a standard occupancy model.  The big difference is that the probabilities for a given detection history are integrated over the possible abundance values.

Anyway, hoping to crowd source the eyes on this and if it checks out, maybe Marc can eventually (kindly) incorporate it into AICcmodavg.

Thanks,
Dan
